sharedHostObservation.scope: Probe intervals only. Shorter overlaps not excluded; other host jobs left running.

protocol: One loaded immutable Q8 model; two privately owned decoder/KV states per case; all backend calls serialized. Synthetic uniform-prefix or actual deterministic token-prefix embeddings; actual appended token embeddings. Opt48; all CPU phase budgets16; physical affinity0-15. Prefix lengths31/32/33,127/128/129,511/512/513,1023/1024/1025 crossed with append1/2/4/8; maxSeq1088. Compare every hidden float, every full-vocabulary logits row, canonical active per-layer K/V bits, positions, first argmax and EOS decision. Rewind to floor(T/2) accepted tokens; poison the complete discarded batch cache suffix with quiet NaNs and verify readback/preserved active state; decode a different actual token and compare complete hidden/logits/KV again. Invalid rewinds preserve state. Inputs, original prefix and accepted cache unchanged; all loaded model bytes checked after96 cases. Continue arithmetic failures to retain full matrix, return1 if any bit or decision differs; exception/incomplete fixture returns2. No arithmetic failure can reach timing. Fixtures do not establish audio transcript or speculative-generator parity; token decisions alone do not satisfy this strict gate. Numeric counts/errors/hashes only; no raw token IDs, embeddings, model bytes, audio, transcripts or credentials.
